Collaborate with development teams for deeper analysis of failures and facilitate their resolution.  Execution of daily/weekly/bi-weekly/on-demand test plans on test equipment platforms and/or live network test beds within schedule and with high quality.  Guide junior modem engineers in test execution, debugging and failure reporting  Flexible, adaptable and open to working 24*7 shifts including morning, evening and night shift  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and reporting skills. Mandatory Skill Sets  Bachelor's degree or higher in telecommunications/electronics/electrical/computer science engineering with 8+ years of experience in modem quality assurance and its associated activities.  In-depth understanding of mobile wireless concepts based on 3GPP protocols and standards, and thorough knowledge of IMS, NR and LTE call flows.  Hands-on exposure to NTN technology and feature validation using test equipment platforms such as R&S/Keysight/Anritsu and/or satellite emulation test beds.  In-depth understanding of 3GPP Rel17/18 NTN specifications and carrier acceptance/certification requirements for NA carriers such as Verizon and T-Mobile.  Hands-on experience of working with Python, Android Framework and Java for test case automation  Exceptional knowledge of working with test equipment platforms like R&S, Keysight, Anritsu and Amarisoft for test case development, automation and execution.  Extensive working experience with UE modem logging tools such as Shannon DM, QXDM, ELT etc

title: Engineering Manager (AWP Lead)
jobDescription:
Procedure • Drive AWP adoption across engineering, procurement, fabrication and construction • Establish governance to ensure consistent AWP execution • Ensure compliance with AWP standards and project procedures • Facilitate monthly AWP process audit reviews • Conduct Early Planning Sessions and Path of Construction Sessions to ensure alignment of Engineering and Procurement with the Path of Construction
2. Work Packaging & Planning Management • Support the definition of CWAs and AWP Nomenclature • Ensure effective development and alignment of: o Engineering Work Packages (EWPs, VEWPs, FEWPs) lookahead planning, ensuring deliverables are proactively prepared to meet future construction needs
3. Engineering Integration (Critical) • Drive construction-driven engineering prioritization • Ensure engineering deliverables are sequenced and structured to support EWPs • Ensure all Construction documents are tied to an EWP/VEWP/FEWP • Review EWPs, VEWPs and FEWPs (Engineering Documentation, Drawings, MTOs, and 3D Models) as they are prepared and issued • Perform detailed interdisciplinary reviews by checking drawings against MTOs, 3D models, and related documents, identify errors, omissions, and inconsistencies • Lead engagement with engineering discipline leads to: o Align deliverables with construction sequencing o Resolve cross-discipline conflicts impacting EWPs • Act as a bridge between engineering and construction based on hands-on engineering leadership experience
4. Material and Procurement • Ensure alignment between AWP and Material Management systems • Ensure material availability aligns with EWP/PWP/CWP/IWP release plans • Ensure all tags are tied to a PWP • Oversee material tracking by tag and its linkage to work packages • Participate in vendor kick-off and weekly meetings to drive implementation of AWP requirements and ensure alignment from project outset • Ensure integration between: • Procurement systems • Logistics systems • Site receiving processes • Drive development of: • Material receiving reports • Shipping and expediting visibility tools
5. Constraint & Change Management • Establish and manage EWP constraint tracking to ensure work packages are executable as planned • Develop and implement the EWP HOLD Management Procedure to manage constraints and release readiness • Ensure effective implementation and governance of EWP HOLD management, including identification, communication, tracking, and release • Develop and maintain the EWP Change Management Procedure • Ensure proper implementation of EWP change management, including evaluation of impacts, controlled updates, and communication tall stakeholders • Own and govern the full EWP Change Management lifecycle, including Change Notices (GNCs), approvals, implementation, and closure • Develop, maintain, and control the EWP change log, ensuring all changes are properly tracked, communicated, and reflected in package revisions • Develop, maintain and control the EWP Review Tracker, ensuring all EWPs are properly reviewed and released • Develop, maintain and control the EWP Distribution Matrix to ensure EWPs are correctly distributed across the organization
6. Cross-Functional Integration & Interfaces • Ensure proper coordination with Project Controls maintain full alignment between Primavera P6 schedules and the AWP Matrix • Ensure proper coordination with Document Control to maintain consistency and alignment between the MDR and the AWP Matrix • Ensure proper coordination with 3D Model and Engineering Discipline Leads to maintain alignment between Engineering Deliverables, 3D Model, MTO, and the AWP Matrix Experience • Engineering Degree • 15-25 years EPC experience • Workface Planning (WFP) experience is a plus
